resources.string: Messages arrive on your target devices, securely encrypted all the way.
Pin Glide keeps no SMS or OTP forwarding history and never uploads plaintext to the Pin Glide service.

SMS content and OTPs stay in memory only during processing and are released on completion or failure. When OTP extraction is needed, this device sends the SMS directly to the Bailian model service. The original SMS is still encrypted and forwarded if extraction fails.

Only the paired clients hold Pairing keys. Android Keystore protects the local copies and model credentials. They never enter logs or URLs, and Pairing keys are never uploaded to the Pin Glide service. Model credentials are used only to authenticate to the model service.
The Pin Glide service routes ciphertext only
This device encrypts the SMS and OTP independently for each target device. The Pin Glide service cannot read the plaintext or client encryption keys.
Diagnostics contain only non-content metadata such as time, result category, status code, request ID and target count. They never record SMS content, OTPs, ciphertext, credentials or keys.

Local identity, credentials and Pairing keys are excluded from cloud backups and device transfers. Uninstalling or clearing app data loses them. Sign in and pair your target devices again; backups cannot restore them.

We recommend finding Pin Glide in system settings and turning off battery optimization. Each new SMS starts only a brief processing task, which stops immediately on completion or failure.
